### Advisories (not blocking)

- A1: `Tests_Ordering_Recommendations_TTP` could carry PLAVIX §5.4 "thrombocytopenia, microangiopathic hemolytic anemia (schistocytes [fragmented RBCs] seen on peripheral smear), neurological findings, renal dysfunction, and fever" as its source.1/quote.1 (it names the platelet count, smear and creatinine).
- A2: add "covers ... only" notes to `blistering_or_peeling_skin` (Bullous eruption: blistering only), `vomiting_or_diarrhea` (combined finding), `leg_numbness_or_tingling` (numbness only), `muscle_cramps_or_spasms` (cramp only), like the existing notes on `bowel_or_bladder_dysfunction`.
- A3: DAPT after ACS can run 12-36 months (Figure 9) under the `DAPT` candidate, while `Monitor_PPI_Bone_Fracture` fires only for `Extended_DAPT`; the label risk is for high-dose (multiple daily doses) and long-term use, so the approved restriction is defensible, but consider it at the next proposal revision.

## Fix list

Deterministic gate: nothing to fix. Judgment FAILs (each needs a proposal revision, since the approved §5/§6/§7 fix the items; then a full re-emit and a full re-review):

- [ ] J1 `Tests_Ordering_Recommendations_Bleeding` / `diastolic_bp`: a collected finding is left out of the gate. Either add `or diastolic_bp < 60` to the precondition (hypotension = systolic < 90 or diastolic < 60 mmHg; record the threshold in the proposal §6 and the Decision description), or drop `diastolic_bp` from `Monitor_Bleeding` (proposal §5/§7). Type-check with `check_expression`.
- [ ] J2 `Order_CYP2C19_Genotype` / `cyp2c19_poor_metabolizer_known`: the gate re-orders genotyping for patients already genotyped as non-poor metabolizers, contradicting the step's procedure ("status is not known"). Replace the boolean with a status item that distinguishes "unknown", e.g. `cyp2c19_status` (range `poor_metabolizer`, `not_poor_metabolizer`, `unknown`; SNOMED:738786005 can stay on it), and gate on `ischemic_event_on_clopidogrel = true and cyp2c19_status = unknown`; or add `cyp2c19_genotype_known` (boolean) and gate on `ischemic_event_on_clopidogrel = true and cyp2c19_genotype_known = false`. Update the Enquiry source, the procedure wording and proposal §5/§6/§7 accordingly.
- [ ] J3 `photosensitive_rash` (asked by `Monitor_PPI_Cutaneous_Lupus`): recode with `snomed_search` to the finding SNOMED:90128006 (Photosensitivity; record the label exactly as returned) in place of SNOMED:69047008 "Photosensitivity caused by drug (disorder)", and update proposal §7; or, if the drug-photosensitivity concept is kept, state in the data item description why it was chosen as the nearest match for a photosensitive rash signalling CLE.
